thoughts: The current Triptych layout is functional but fails to capture the 'infrastructure' and 'blueprint' nature of Bluetone's mission. By transitioning to a BLUEPRINT layout strategy, we shift from a standard SaaS pricing feel to a technical, high-assurance engineering specification. The UI will now use a technical grid background, monospaced accents, and high-contrast data points to reassure municipal stakeholders of the technical rigor behind the autonomous fleet. We've introduced forensic evidence items (uptime, regulatory success) and field testimonials to ground the 'Visionary' claims in reality.
